title: Tom Lee Says Ethereum Can 10x, but Almost Nobody Read the Condition
speaker: tastylive host (Options Math Check), citing Tom Lee

macro_themes.view: Tom Lee's 10x Ethereum call only starts if ETH first breaks 5,000, above the 4,946 all-time high.

calls.condition: Tom Lee: if ETH breaks 5,000 it could go 10x (~50,000). Host: options price 5,000 as a ~1 SD move by Dec 2027, unlikely by year-end.
calls.reason: ETHA options: year-end 2 SD range only reaches the low 30s (ETH ~4,000s), but Dec 2027 1 SD reaches ~38 ETHA (= ETH 5,000), so 5,000 looks probable over about two years.
calls.quote: So it's looking pretty probable over the next two years or so that we get to that level up at 38

notes: Host is analyzing Tom Lee's conditional claim and notes his conflict (Bitmine chair). Long-term 5,000 target is the options-implied 1 SD by Dec 2027, not a forecast with conviction. ETHA 38 equivalent to ETH 5,000. No date stated; listing Oct 6.
